name: Bioluminescent Night Tide
promptTemplate: A nighttime shoreline illuminated by {{bloom_color}} bioluminescent plankton with {{wave_energy}} wave surge rolling at {{wave_speed}} swell speed under a {{sky_mode}} sky, radiating {{glow_intensity}} bioluminescent glow with {{shore_foam}} shore foam wash, active sparks spray: {{shoal_sparks}}, and wet sand reflection: {{wet_sand_mirror}}.

ui.title: NIGHT TIDE // LUMEN
ui.tagline: Bioluminescent surf on a pitch-black midnight shore

bloom_color.hint: Shift plankton hue along the breaking crests

wave_energy.hint: Heighten breaker agitation and crest surge

glow_intensity.hint: Drive radiant luminescence and spray brightness

shore_foam.hint: Foam cell thickness spreading onto wet sand

shoal_sparks.hint: Ignite glowing droplets flung from the surf

wet_sand_mirror.hint: Reflect glowing surf in wet tidal flats

listing.blurb: Electric waves break in glowing bioluminescent hues across a dark beach, radiating light as foam washes the sand under a starry sky.
listing.prompt: A beach at night where every breaking wave glows electric blue with plankton, the light blooming along the crest and fading as the foam retreats, stars above a black sea. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
